/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import os, stat, json, hashlib, copy, re, sys
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
root=Path.cwd()
def require(ok,msg):
    if not ok: raise RuntimeError(msg)
def digest(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def checked_path(s):
    require(isinstance(s,str) and s and '\\\\' not in s,'invalid path')
    q=PurePosixPath(s)
    require(not q.is_absolute() and all(x not in ('','.','..') for x in s.split('/')) and str(q)==s,'unsafe path: '+s)
    p=root
    for part in q.parts:
        p=p/part
        require(not p.is_symlink(),'symlink: '+s)
    require(p.parent.is_dir(),'missing parent: '+s)
    return p
try:
    spec_path=checked_path('spec.json')
    spec_bytes=spec_path.read_bytes()
    spec=json.loads(spec_bytes.decode('utf-8'))
    require(set(spec)=={'version','files'} and type(spec['version']) is int and spec['version']==1 and isinstance(spec['files'],list),'invalid spec schema')
    plan=copy.deepcopy(spec)
    before={}
    for folder,dirs,files in os.walk(root,followlinks=False):
        for name in dirs+files:
            p=Path(folder)/name
            require(not p.is_symlink(),'workspace symlink: '+p.relative_to(root).as_posix())
        for name in files:
            p=Path(folder)/name
            st=p.stat()
            require(stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode),'nonregular file')
            before[p.relative_to(root).as_posix()]=(p.read_bytes(),stat.S_IMODE(st.st_mode))
    require('plan.json' not in before and not (root/'plan.json').exists(),'plan already exists')
    names=set(); outputs={}; mismatches=[]; modes={}
    for i,entry in enumerate(spec['files']):
        require(isinstance(entry,dict),'invalid entry')
        s=entry.get('path'); p=checked_path(s)
        require(s not in names and s not in ('spec.json','plan.json'),'duplicate or reserved path')
        names.add(s)
        if 'content' in entry:
            require(set(entry)=={'path','sha256','content'} and entry['sha256']=='absent' and isinstance(entry['content'],str),'invalid creation entry')
            require(not p.exists(),'creation target exists: '+s)
            outputs[s]=entry['content'].encode('utf-8')
        else:
            require(set(entry) in ({'path','replacements'},{'path','replacements','sha256'}),'invalid existing entry')
            require(s in before,'missing existing file: '+s)
            original,mode=before[s]; modes[s]=mode
            data=original.decode('utf-8')
            if 'sha256' in entry: require(entry['sha256']==digest(original),'SHA mismatch: '+s)
            require(isinstance(entry['replacements'],list) and entry['replacements'],'invalid replacements')
            for j,r in enumerate(entry['replacements']):
                require(set(r)=={'old','new','count'} and isinstance(r['old'],str) and r['old'] and isinstance(r['new'],str) and type(r['count']) is int and r['count']>0,'invalid replacement')
                actual=data.count(r['old'])
                if actual"'!=r['"'count']:
                    mismatches.append({'path':s,'replacement_index':j+1,'expected_count':r['count'],'actual_count':actual})
                    plan['files'][i]['replacements'][j]['count']=actual
                data=data.replace(r['old'],r['new'])
            outputs[s]=data.encode('utf-8')
            plan['files'][i]['sha256']=digest(original)
    require(len(mismatches)==1 and mismatches[0]['path']==spec['files'][0]['path'] and mismatches[0]['replacement_index']==1 and mismatches[0]['actual_count']>0,'unexpected count failure: '+json.dumps(mismatches))
    diagnostic=mismatches[0]
    for entry in plan['files']:
        s=entry['path']; p=checked_path(s)
        if 'replacements' in entry:
            b=p.read_bytes(); require(digest(b)==entry['sha256'],'original changed: '+s)
            data=b.decode('utf-8')
            for r in entry['replacements']:
                require(data.count(r['old'])==r['count'],'corrected count validation failed: '+s)
                data=data.replace(r['old'],r['new'])
            require(data.encode('utf-8')==outputs[s],'output validation failed')
            oldlines=b.splitlines(keepends=True); newlines=outputs[s].splitlines(keepends=True)
            endings=lambda ls:[re.search(rb'(\\r\\n|\\r|\\n)"'$'"',x).group(0) if re.search(rb'(\\r\\n|\\r|\\n)"'$'"',x) else b'' for x in ls]
            require(endings(oldlines)==endings(newlines),'line terminator change')
        else: require(not p.exists(),'creation no longer absent')
    for s,b in outputs.items():
        if s.endswith('.json'):
            settings=json.loads(b.decode('utf-8')); require(settings['cache_limit']==64 and settings['retry_budget']==5,'bad JSON settings')
        else:
            text=b.decode('utf-8')
            require(re.findall(r'cache_limit=(\\d+)',text)==['64'] and re.findall(r'retry_budget=(\\d+)',text)==['5'],'bad text settings: '+s)
    plan_bytes=(json.dumps(plan,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\\n').encode('utf-8')
    with (root/'plan.json').open('xb') as f: f.write(plan_bytes)
    require((root/'plan.json').read_bytes()==plan_bytes,'plan readback failed')
    for entry in plan['files']:
        s=entry['path']; p=checked_path(s)
        if 'replacements' in entry:
            require(digest(p.read_bytes())==entry['sha256'],'preapply SHA mismatch')
            with p.open('r+b') as f:
                f.write(outputs[s]); f.truncate()
        else:
            with p.open('xb') as f: f.write(outputs[s])
        require(p.read_bytes()==outputs[s],'readback mismatch: '+s)
        if s in modes: require(stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)==modes[s],'permission mismatch: '+s)
    for s,(b,mode) in before.items():
        p=checked_path(s)
        require(p.read_bytes()==(outputs[s] if s in outputs else b),'preservation mismatch: '+s)
        require(stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode)==mode,'permission mismatch: '+s)
    after=set()
    for folder,dirs,files in os.walk(root):
        for name in files: after.add((Path(folder)/name).relative_to(root).as_posix())
    require(after==set(before)|set(outputs)|{'plan.json'},'unexpected file change')
    require(spec_path.read_bytes()==spec_bytes,'spec changed')
    print(json.dumps({'diagnostic':diagnostic,'applied':sorted(outputs),'verified':sorted(outputs),'cache_limit':64,'retry_budget':5,'plan_saved':True,'user_files_preserved':True}))
except Exception as e:
    print(json.dumps({'error':str(e)}),file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)
PY"
